newsitem.title: USA: US Midwest spot propane bounces back in late trade.
newsitem.headline: US Midwest spot propane bounces back in late trade.

text.p: U.S. Midwest spot propane prices recovered from morning losses late Wednesday, climbing several cents on continued concerns over low regional inventories, players said.

In the Midwest trading hub of Conway, Kansas, one prompt parcel was sold for 95.0 cents a gallon in the afternoon, with an any-month deal spotted at 92.5 cents, dealers said -- slightly better than late Tuesday prices.
Mont Belvieu, Texas, material was talked 1.5 cents higher than the morning at 62.50 cents, although prices remained five cents below Tuesday levels, traders said.
